**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Forward template mode to the COW preflight**

When `MemtableMode == "cow_btree"` is combined with a non-off `ValueLog.TemplateMode`, this preflight constructs `caching.Options` without `ValueLogTemplateMode`, so `ValidateCOWOpenOptions` sees zero and succeeds. The later `caching.Open` call receives the actual template mode and rejects it, but by then the backend and side stores may already have created files, violating the COW invalid-open no-storage-effect contract. Pass `opts.ValueLog.TemplateMode` into this initial validation.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
